terms.meaning: setup data that pytest creates and hands to any test that asks for it by name
the setting that makes a fixture build once for the whole test run instead of once per test
a saved reference run of the whole pipeline, used as a fixed point for comparison

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Sets up import paths and shared builders
sections.what: Adds the project and scripts folders to the import path, then imports the engine input builder and the golden run builder so the fixtures can use them.
sections.why: The file's docstring says it provides fixtures for end-to-end value tests, and the path lines let it import the project code.
sections.watch_out: Changing the import path here affects every test file loaded after this one.

sections.name: golden
sections.title: Shares one golden run across the session
sections.what: Provides the golden run to value tests, built once for the whole session.
sections.why: Likely reason: building the run is expensive and many tests use the same result.
sections.watch_out: A test that changes the run object alters what later tests see.

sections.name: engine
sections.title: Converts the golden run into engine inputs
sections.what: Turns the golden run into the input bundle the value engine takes, using its records, cases, case ids and prerequisite edges.
sections.why: Likely reason: value tests need engine inputs rather than the raw run, and this avoids repeating the conversion in each test.
sections.watch_out: Depends on the exact fields of the golden run; a renamed field breaks every test that requests this fixture.

summary: Sets up shared test data for the value engine tests: one golden run and the engine inputs built from it, each created once per test session.
purpose: Gives every value test the same starting data, so each test does not rebuild the golden run.
why: Likely reason: building the golden run is costly, so it is shared. The session scope means it is built once for the whole test run.
how: 1) Adds the project root and the scripts folder to the import path. 2) Imports the engine input builder from the pipeline script and the golden run builder from the test helpers. 3) Provides a shared golden run. 4) Builds engine inputs from that run, using its records, cases, case ids and prerequisite edges.
outputs: Two fixtures named golden and engine, which test functions request by name.
risks: Session scope means one shared object: a test that changes it changes what later tests see. The path lines also affect every test file loaded after this one.
debug: If many value tests fail at once, check this file first for import errors or problems in the golden run builder. Confirm scripts/run_pipeline.py still provides the engine input function. Run a single test alone to see whether the failure comes from shared state.
